📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-04-crm-amqp-consumer-monitor-family-quiet-period-flap`
This is occurrence #39 in the last 7 days.
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `CRM Experience` (`@customer-management` / `#team-customer-management`)
Playbook: Confirm via dd_search.py metric — expect a brief dip below the monitor's floor threshold then a fast recovery, not a real stall; escalate only if unresolved after ~1h or a sibling latency/error monitor co-fires.
Open Jira: n/a

Source alerts (1 total):
  • n/a — degraded mode, no Slack MCP this cycle; alert reconstructed from DD monitor scan diff. Source: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/302057011

Evidence:
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/302057011
  • DD metric: https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?live=false&page=0&exp_metric=trace.amqp.command.hits&exp_scope=service%3Aruntime-core-subscriber%2Cenv%3Aprod&exp_agg=sum&start=1783650511&end=1783654111
  • This-window concentration: n/a — infra throughput monitor, not account-scoped; sustained near-zero rate (0.15–10.1/s) for ~12–15min pre-fire then a catch-up burst to 224.6/s, 0 service:runtime-core-subscriber status:error logs confirms no real stall.

Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Admin` (`@admin` / `#team-admin`)

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-04-crm-amqp-consumer-monitor-family-quiet-period-flap`
This is occurrence #40 in the last 7 days.
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Admin` (`@admin` / `#team-admin`) — note: this KB entry's owning-team attribution has alternated between Admin and CRM Experience across prior occurrences of this exact monitor (mobile-notifications-stack maps to Admin per ownership.md; the monitor's own DD tag says team:crm) — pre-existing data-quality ambiguity, not resolved this cycle.
Playbook: Same family as ki-...-runtime-core-subscriber (occurrence #39, posted earlier this cycle) — confirm via dd_search.py metric, expect a brief near-threshold dip that self-resolves, not a real stall.
Open Jira: n/a

Source alerts (1 total):

  • DD metric: https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?live=false&page=0&exp_metric=trace.amqp.command.hits&exp_scope=service%3Amethod-mobile-notifications-subscriber%2Cenv%3Aprod&exp_agg=sum&start=1783674621&end=1783678221
  • This-window concentration: n/a — infra heartbeat monitor; rate stayed 0.05–0.4/s throughout the sampled window (never actually below the 0.005/s threshold at this rollup granularity), 0 errors on the service. Note: this post fired via the every-10th-occurrence resurface rule — last_notified_at had just been reset ~6h42m earlier this same cycle by the sibling runtime-core-subscriber fire, which would otherwise have suppressed this one.

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-07-gateway-4xx-spike-monitor-noise`
This is occurrence #5 in the last 7 days.
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Admin` (`@admin` / `#team-admin`)
Playbook: Check ms-authentication-api / Redis JWT-cache health as the likely mechanism for brief 4xx bursts; escalate immediately if duration lengthens or 5xx/real user reports appear — this monitor guards the platform's single point of failure (ms-gateway-api).
